text:
Ellen (Hiring Manager): New PM joining Tues. Can someone drop a short manager-only checklist I can paste into our hiring playbook? Need: pre-day ops, a tight day-by-day week1, a 30/60/90 that focuses on measurable outcomes, and a tiny list of manager deliverables (what I must do).
Jules (People Ops): Drafting a manager-facing checklist below  kept it action-oriented so managers can copy/paste.
Rex (IT): I'll provision laptop + SSO once you DM me the email and preferred OS. Heads-up: VPN/HSM adds 3 business days.
Nina (Buddy): I can be the buddy. I'll run a 45-min product tour day 1 and a 90-min pairing session day 2.
Carlos (Eng Lead): I'll create a small onboarding ticket that validates repo access, CI run, and a test deploy. Good first task for confidence + permissions.
Jules (People Ops): Manager-only checklist (copy-paste):
```
Manager onboarding checklist - copyable snippet
PRE-DAY
- Confirm device type & shipping address with IT; list any special SaaS (analytics, design, infra)
- Create calendar invites: Day0 welcome, Day1 product deep-dive, recurring 1:1 (weekly x8)
- Assign buddy and add to "who-to-ask" doc
- Prepare 1-line decision authority note (what they can decide vs escalate)

WEEK 1 (day-by-day)
- Day0: Welcome DM, HR forms + benefits link, Slack intro in #team
- Day1: Product walkthrough (manager + buddy), verify repo & staging access, share top 3 docs
- Day2: Pair on first tiny ticket (assign Carlos' CI/deploy validation), run through local dev setup
- Day3: Stakeholder intros (10-20m each), review week 1 goals & quick feedback loop
- Day4: Metrics & monitoring tour, identify first discovery area, set immediate 30-day measurable
- End of week: Manager writes 30/60/90 draft in doc, lists 3 success signals, schedule week2 feedback

MANAGER DELIVERABLES (what manager must do)
- Approve device + SaaS list pre-day
- Add buddy and schedule recurring 1:1s
- Provide a written 30/60/90 and 3 success signals by EOW
- Define decision boundaries and delegation plan within week 1
- Give role-specific onboarding tasks (tiny ticket) and accept first PR within week 2
```
Ellen (Hiring Manager): Good. Can you also suggest a compact, outcome-focused 30/60/90 I can DM the hire?
Jules (People Ops): Short 30/60/90 (pasteable):
- 30 days: Complete the onboarding checklist, run the CI/dev validation ticket, and deliver a one-page discovery note with prioritized next steps.
- 60 days: Own a small backlog slice, lead at least one cross-functional sync, and propose 2 concrete improvements with acceptance criteria.
- 90 days: Lead a scoped launch (planning -> rollout) that moves a target metric (engagement, latency, or error rate) and demonstrate a stable stakeholder cadence.
Ellen (Hiring Manager): I want tangible success signals too  three per milestone?
Jules (People Ops): Seed signals (managers edit as needed):
- 30-day signals: passes CI/deploy validation, delivered discovery doc, completed all required trainings
- 60-day signals: merged >=3 independent PRs, ran cross-team sync with agenda & notes, owned a backlog board
- 90-day signals: led an end-to-end release, quantitative improvement on target metric, routine 1:1s with stakeholders established
Rex (IT): Ordered device. ETA 3 business days. Sending SSO invite now. If MDM blocks, I'll spin a cloud dev VM for immediate access.
Nina (Buddy): I'll add a quick "who-to-ask" table to the doc: repos -> Carlos, staging -> #qa, deploys -> Devops lead, metrics -> Data Eng.
Carlos (Eng Lead): Ticket created: "onboard/ci-check"  simple PR that runs CI and verifies a staging deploy. I'll assign on Day1.
onboard-bot: Reminder created: "New hire Day0 welcome" scheduled for 2024-09-03 09:00. :tada:
Ellen (Hiring Manager): Thanks all. I'll paste the manager snippet into the hiring playbook and DM the candidate the 30/60/90 + success signals. Jules  please add this snippet to the manager template library and mark as editable for role-specific items.
Jules (People Ops): Done  added as "mgr_playbook_ramp_kpis" to templates and shared with hiring managers. Will ping folks to add role-specific items by Friday.
